senses.zh_definition: 里奇；英语语境中的人名或姓氏。具体指谁须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A personal name or surname; the particular bearer must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama orang atau nama keluarga; individu yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是专名说明，并非 DBP 普通词义。中文“里奇”是常见音译，具体人物可能另有约定译名。以下是示例性姓名短语，不代表已测得的高频搭配。[Ritchie 姓氏资料](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/Ritchie)

dual_scenarios.zh: 里奇先生将作为公司代表出席该会议。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Ritchie will attend the meeting as the company's representative.

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ritchie dah sampai ke? Aku nak mula mesyuarat ni.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Ritchie sudah sampai? Saya mahu memulakan mesyuarat ini.
messages.zh: 里奇到了吗？我想开始开会了。
messages.en: Has Ritchie arrived yet? I'd like to start the meeting.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia kat lobi. Aku panggil dia naik sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Dia sudah sampai dan berada di lobi. Saya akan memintanya naik sekarang.
messages.zh: 到了，他在大厅。我现在叫他上来。
messages.en: Yes, he's in the lobby. I'll ask him to come up now.

etymology.historical_story: Ritchie is associated with Scottish and northern English familiar forms of Richard. A familiar personal name could become a hereditary surname, preserving an earlier naming relationship across generations. That history does not identify any particular bearer in this packet, and it does not supply an ordinary Malay lexical meaning. [Dictionary of American Family Names, via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/Ritchie)
